name: builtin-bug-fix
description: Small bug-fixing benchmark. Each case asks UR to fix a known defect in a fresh worktree and verify with a test command.

cases.prompt: Fix the off-by-one defect in the existing src/findIndex.js without changing its public API. Add focused tests covering first, middle, last, and missing elements, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only if they pass.

expect.testCommand: node --input-type=module -e "import {findIndex} from './src/findIndex.js'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; assert.equal(findIndex(['a','b','c'],'c'),2); assert.equal(findIndex(['a'],'a'),0); assert.equal(findIndex(['a'],'x'),-1)"

cases.prompt: Fix the existing src/greet.js so null, undefined, and blank input return 'Hello, stranger' while names keep the documented uppercase greeting. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only if they pass.

expect.testCommand: node --input-type=module -e "import {greet} from './src/greet.js'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; assert.equal(greet(null),'Hello, stranger'); assert.equal(greet(undefined),'Hello, stranger'); assert.equal(greet('  '),'Hello, stranger'); assert.equal(greet('Ada'),'Hello, ADA')"

cases.prompt: Fix the existing src/fetcher.js so its try/catch handles a loader's asynchronous rejection and returns the documented fallback. Preserve the public API, add focused resolved/rejected tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only if they pass.

expect.testCommand: node --input-type=module -e "import {fetchData} from './src/fetcher.js'; import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; assert.equal(await fetchData(async()=>42),42); assert.equal(await fetchData(async()=>{throw new Error('x')}),'fallback')"
